title: Canonical localization filtration descends to filtered derived objects
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion with complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring. Use the ordinary abelian categories of sheaves of modules over the constant ring $\Lambda$ on the small etale sites [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Here inverse image, direct image and extension by zero are those of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. The bounded filtered derived localization means bounded cochain complexes with finite decreasing filtrations by subcomplexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-sp-filtration, def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], localized at chain maps inducing quasi-isomorphisms on every graded complex. Suppose that $j^{-1}$, $i^{-1}$, $j_!$ and $i_*$ are exact and that, for every bounded complex $B^\bullet$ of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$, the degreewise localization sequence
$$0\to j_!j^{-1}B^\bullet\to B^\bullet\to i_*i^{-1}B^\bullet\to0,$$
formed from the counit of $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$ and the unit of $i^{-1}\dashv i_*$, is exact. The assignment
$$F^0B^\bullet=B^\bullet,\qquad F^1B^\bullet=j_!j^{-1}B^\bullet,\qquad F^2B^\bullet=0$$
sends quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms on every associated graded complex. It therefore descends to a functorial section of the forgetful functor from the bounded filtered derived localization to the bounded derived category. The descended filtered object is canonically independent of the chosen representative, and its graded pieces are $i_*i^{-1}B^\bullet$ in degree $0$ and $j_!j^{-1}B^\bullet$ in degree $1$.
